note: [r2:3] The flat-roof data fix: flat roofs rendered far brighter (near white, often slightly pink) than the 2026-03-11 Earth top view, where they are mid-grey concrete or membrane. The stored colour of every clean flat lot of the captured cells that sat more than 4 L* (5 L* for a colour that an override had typed in) off its Earth reading is set to that reading (data/anime/earth-roofs.json: the median of the roof polygon's 60 % core on the top view). A flat roof renders as painted since town/flatroof.js takes the renderer's +3.5 L* out, so the stored colour IS the Earth colour. Not touched: lots with solar modules (skip pv in earth-roofs.json), roofs the GSI photo shows as trees (veg), landmark models, the lots of zz-photos.json and the photo-survey south shore (x -80..200, z 0..140). Contaminated readings (shadow, canopy) cannot be told from a dark roof by colour: 16/58541/25069/366 and 16/58542/25066/200 were hand-checked on the top view.
